notes: PD: focused on RAG for client-facing research portal. Primary lift: migrate embeddings -> unified embed pipeline + swap reranker from lightweight bi-encoder to cross-encoder re-ranker for top-k candidate re-score. Scale: current index ~12M docs (30B tokens), daily ingest ~100k docs. Latency targets: <=250ms p95 for search+rerank (with cross-encoder expected to bump cost). Peak QPS ~120 q/s; steady 20-30 q/s. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for quality if ROI validated. Evals-driven migration: customer demands no negative regressions on relevance metrics; wants automated evals against 5k labeled queries, A/B and canary rollout support, and rollback automation. "Embedding" candidates: 'openembed-2' vs 'svl-legacy-embed' vs hosted-ada-like. "Reranker" candidates: bi-encoder + lightweight MLP vs cross-encoder (Xformer small). Main ask: show NDCG uplift >=4% and MRR uplift >=3% without >2x cost per query or >1.5x p95 latency. "Notes from last call": "If we see a 5% regression we can't ship" — legal also flagged EU data residency for subset of records. POC timeline ~8 weeks (canary 2 weeks, rollout 4 weeks, monitoring+evals 2 weeks). Need SSO/SAML test users and dedicated logging retention 12 months. Links: drive deck + eval harness: drive:/StratumVector/evals/harness-v2.tgz. Jira: opened INF-3421 for canary infra questions.
